confidence_basis: Labels by three team members on the image the models read; three chips; no ground check.
what_this_is: Four classifiers fitted on the team's labels of two chips and scored on the third, each chip left out once, beside the two hand-written rules on the same 300 points. Agreement with the readers of an image; no ground check.
scoring_label: The label at least two of the three gave, where it is water or not water.

models.logistic: logistic regression on the twelve features, standardised, C = 1
models.forest: random forest, 500 trees, at least 5 points in a leaf
models.boosting: gradient-boosted trees (histogram), depth 3, 200 rounds, learning rate 0.1

decision.rule: A model is called better than rule v2 only if, in the area-weighted run and over the three chips together, its difference with rule v2 is above zero by more than 2.4977 standard errors (95% shared over 4 comparisons).

limits: All three team members gave the same label on 57% of the points: a model learns the majority's reading, with its mistakes.
Three chips make three folds; a chip is one image of one place on one day.
The points were drawn in groups cut from rule v1. Area weights correct the estimate; they do not put points where rule v1 never looked.
No ground check exists for any of the three chips, and none of them covers Mae Sai.
